HelloStartupTerms.title: Hello Free For Startups — Terms & Conditions
HelloStartupTerms.lead: These Terms & Conditions govern participation in the Hello Free for Startups Program in Spain/EU. Please read them carefully before applying — by submitting an application you accept these Terms.

sections.title: About this Program
sections.content: The Hello Free for Startups Program ("Program") is offered by MSG91 ("MSG91", "we", "us"). It provides eligible early-stage businesses complimentary access to the Hello platform ("Hello"), subject to these Terms & Conditions ("Terms"). By applying, you accept these Terms.

sections.title: Eligibility
sections.lead: To qualify, the Business must, at application and throughout Free Access:
list: be a validly registered business entity in Spain/EU (SL, SA, or registered Autónomo);
have annual revenue below the Qualifying Threshold, evidenced by financial statements or tax returns;
submit complete and accurate Verification Documents;
operate only one free account per registered entity; and
sections.footer: MSG91 has sole discretion to determine and re-assess eligibility.

sections.title: Mandatory verification documents
list: a financial statement or annual tax return for the most recent financial year showing annual revenue below €50,000;
proof of business registration (e.g. CIF / Registro Mercantil / Autónomo registration); and
a signed self-declaration confirming the revenue figure and that the information provided is true.
sections.callout: Applications lacking valid financial documentation will not be processed. Submission of false or misleading documents results in immediate disqualification and termination.

sections.title: Free tier scope & usage limits
list: Up to 1,000 support tickets per calendar month;
AI usage subject to a fair-use policy.
sections.footer: Features not included in the free tier, and external usage-based charges (e.g., WhatsApp/Meta conversation fees, SMS carrier charges, telephony), are excluded and payable separately by the Business.

sections.title: Exceeding usage limits
sections.content: If the Business exceeds any Usage Limit, MSG91 may invite the Business to upgrade to a paid plan. Continued use beyond the limits requires a paid subscription.

sections.title: Duration & annual eligibility review
sections.content: Free Access continues while the Business remains eligible. MSG91 will review eligibility annually and may request updated Verification Documents.

sections.title: Loss of eligibility & conversion to paid
sections.content: If the Business exceeds the Qualifying Threshold or Usage Limits, Free Access may convert to a paid Hello plan upon notice. The Business retains its data.

sections.title: Fair & acceptable use
sections.content: Free Access is solely for the Business's own genuine customer-support operations. Reselling, sharing access, and multiple accounts per entity are prohibited.

sections.title: Data protection
sections.content: Verification Documents and personal data are processed in accordance with MSG91's Privacy Policy and EU GDPR.

sections.title: Service provided "as is"
sections.content: Free Access is provided on an "as is" and "as available" basis without contractual SLA.

sections.title: Suspension & termination
sections.content: MSG91 may suspend or terminate Free Access for breach of these Terms, ineligibility, or misuse.

sections.title: Changes to the Program or Terms
sections.content: MSG91 may modify or discontinue the Program or these Terms at any time with prior notice.

sections.title: Limitation of liability
sections.content: To the maximum extent permitted by law, MSG91 is not liable for indirect or consequential loss arising from the Program.

sections.title: Governing law & jurisdiction
sections.content: These Terms are governed by the laws of Spain / EU.

sections.title: Contact
sections.content: For questions about the Program: support@msg91.com.
